projects.title: Forecasting Weather-Driven Price Dynamics Across Sri Lankan Tea Market Catalogues
projects.description: A research project investigating weather-driven and market-related factors affecting Sri Lankan tea auction prices. The workflow extracts structured data from weekly reports, integrates historical weather information, performs time-aware feature engineering and causality analysis, and evaluates machine learning models for pooled and catalogue-specific price forecasting.

projects.title: Autonomous Mobile Manipulation Robot | SLRC 2026
projects.description: A fully autonomous mobile manipulation robot developed for the Sri Lanka Robotics Challenge 2026. The system integrates autonomous navigation, computer vision, AprilTag detection, sensor fusion, path tracking, and a 5-DOF robotic arm with motion planning for coordinated pick-and-place tasks.

projects.title: Micro Mouse Robot
projects.description: An autonomous maze-solving robot designed to navigate and explore maze environments using sensor-based perception, embedded control, and real-time path-planning techniques for efficient traversal.

projects.title: Clinic Appointment and Treatment Management System
projects.description: A healthcare-focused web application designed to streamline clinic appointment and treatment management through a user-friendly interface and organized digital workflows for managing patient-related activities.

projects.title: 4-bit Nano Processor
projects.description: A custom 4-bit nano processor implemented in VHDL to demonstrate fundamental CPU architecture concepts. The processor integrates a register bank, ALU, instruction decoder, clock generator, and control logic while supporting arithmetic, data movement, negation, and conditional jump instructions.

projects.title: LifeLine | Blood Bank Management System
projects.description: A full-stack blood bank management platform connecting donors, hospitals, and administrators. The system supports donation campaigns, blood inventory monitoring, hospital blood requests, role-based user management, authentication, and real-time coordination of blood-bank operations.

projects.title: Autonomous Potato Sorting Robot | SLRC 2025
projects.description: An autonomous agricultural robot developed for SLRC 2025 that navigates a grid-like environment, detects and classifies potatoes using computer vision, collects them with a robotic gripper, and sorts good and defective potatoes into separate compartments.

projects.title: Sri Lanka Holiday Dataset
projects.description: A structured Sri Lankan calendar and holiday dataset created by collecting, cleaning, validating, and integrating holiday information from public sources. The project combines automated data extraction and processing workflows to produce analysis-ready calendar features for downstream data science and forecasting applications.

projects.title: Automated Glaucoma Screening System
projects.type: Deep Learning | Computer Vision | Healthcare AI
projects.description: An AI-based glaucoma screening system that analyzes retinal fundus images using deep learning and machine learning. The pipeline combines optic disc and cup segmentation, image-based feature extraction, and predictive models to estimate glaucoma risk from retinal imagery.

projects.title: Point of Sale (POS) System
projects.description: A Java-based Point of Sale application designed to manage cashier operations, products, billing, discounts, payments, and sales transactions. The project applies object-oriented programming principles and persistent CSV-based data handling through an interactive command-line interface.
